marketing_description: The DeWALT MAX XR Series DCD1007B Hammer Drill features a brushless motor and 11 clutch settings, providing a torque rating of 2100 in-lb and 38250 blows per minute. This cordless hammer drill has a 1/2 in keyless chuck and offers 3 speed settings, making it suitable for various applications. With its pivoting 3-position LED and anti-rotation system, this tool is designed to help illuminate work areas and prevent bind ups.
